reason: All initial July fits failed. Broaden the train-only parameter search and lengthen simulation before opening August or September observations.
training_sources: Only the original frozen July training summaries and source files; no August or September observations have been extracted.
design: Original selected config, original 24 fixed candidates, then seeded independent log-uniform draws within the amended bounds, up to exactly 128 configurations.
selection: Minimize largest family error plus 10 times invalid simulation fraction, then mean family error; confirm the eight screening finalists on fresh training-only simulator seeds and select by the same fixed criterion.
gate: Unchanged DEFAULT_GATE from original protocols, including maximum family error 0.60. No threshold changes, no strategy-result optimization.
stop_rule: One bounded amended search per cohort. Freeze all models before August extraction. No further model change after validation or holdout. Failed gates remain failed.
evaluation_order: August first, September once after all selected models are frozen. Instrument models evaluate their own instrument; pooled model evaluates both. Outputs are retained irrespective of failure.
